field_checks.summary: Primary XML/PDF and Supplementary Data workbook activity surfaces were independently checked. The current final has 130 MIC records matching the source-surface count: Supplementary Data 3 = 76, Supplementary Data 4 = 36, Supplementary Data 10 = 18. Raw values/units and row/cell locators matched the workbook except preserved nonquantitative N/N* cases, which are explicitly not converted.

The release boundary is preserved at the top level: four fallback DBAASP machine rows remain unresolved_record, linked authoritative rows are absent, and authoritative_dbaasp_ingest_ready is false. However, the current database final still has material subcheck fields inside duplicated fallback-row audits that mark sequence/name/modification checks as source_verified while the fallback rows have sequence "None" and no authoritative linked database sequence/modification row. That conflates source-local candidate identity with database-record verification.

The five current paper-final JSON files are byte-identical to the five current packet-final mirrors, and the packet mechanism_evidence.json alias is byte-identical to mechanism_ontology_record.json. The live packet rework state has zero open tickets and review_report open_rework_ticket_count is zero. Blocking inconsistency remains because current materials_manifest.json still contains worker1_live_state_sync.open_rework_ticket_count = 16 with 16 open IDs, so not all current final ticket metadata is current.

The four mechanism claims preserve evidence-strength boundaries: one direct PI/permeability claim, one computational-only AlphaFold/predicted-structure claim, one inferred physicochemical/design-rationale claim, and one phenotype-supported MIC/activity claim. Direct assay types are present only for the direct mechanism claim, and source locators resolve.

Paper identity was independently verified from XML/PDF metadata: PMCID PMC12125351, PMID 40447738, DOI 10.1038/s42003-025-08282-7, title AMPGen, Communications Biology, 2025. Source-local candidate identities for p15, p17, and p20 match Supplementary Data 3/4 sequences and independently counted lengths 26, 29, and 32.

All non-database final source locators resolved in locator_index, no source_locator/supporting_source_locator pointed to work/final/analysis artifacts, and activity/toxicity normalization statuses were explicit. Caution: database fallback provenance uses mixed locator spellings, database:DBAASP:fallback-machine-row and database:DBAASP:fallback_machine_row, and the database subcheck status issue is blocking under database_record_verification.
